name: @fleet/server
description: Telemetry ingest, vendor adapters, in-memory fleet state, freshness sweep, HTTP reads, WebSocket delta fan-out, and the deterministic simulator that feeds it.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,sim -c green,cyan "tsx watch src/main.ts" "tsx src/simulator/main.ts"
scripts.start:stack: concurrently -n server,sim -c green,cyan "tsx src/main.ts" "tsx src/simulator/main.ts --robots 24 --seed 1 --hz 4 --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:${FLEET_PORT:-8080}"
